current_security_bridge.reason: No owner-produced real participant/security bridge was acquired in R8.

private_binding.reason: Existing storage protocols found; no approved/exercised GMI private-assertion binding or source-retention receipt obtained.

cases.description: Initially admitted synthetic policy permits emission.
Same-path policy revocation remains allowed in the already-warm module.
Explicit invalidation observes revocation and refuses.
Same-path policy arrival remains refused after an earlier missing-file read.
Explicit invalidation observes the new reviewed policy.
A separately read policy revision path observes refusal without reusing old path cache.

acceptance_cases.scenario: Existing GLP-1 theme and primary price basket have different IDs.
acceptance_cases.intended_result: Preserve glp1_obesity and obesity_glp1 separately; no basket mutation.

acceptance_cases.scenario: Navigate all twelve families with unequal research depth.
acceptance_cases.intended_result: Show selective depth and unresolved data; mint no new canonical theme or basket.

acceptance_cases.scenario: Named licensor lacks a validated current security bridge.
acceptance_cases.intended_result: Retain source attribution; omit valuation/performance/portfolio linkage.

acceptance_cases.scenario: A syntactically plausible co: ID is supplied without an owner receipt.
acceptance_cases.intended_result: Refuse required security composition; a fixture ID never proves resolution.

acceptance_cases.scenario: The reported right is a royalty on worldwide net sales.
acceptance_cases.intended_result: Preserve parties, scope and denominator; do not label profit-sharing or manufacturing.

acceptance_cases.scenario: Only qualitative royalty tiers are disclosed.
acceptance_cases.intended_result: Keep numeric rate and EPS sensitivity unavailable; never substitute a midpoint.

acceptance_cases.scenario: A development/commercialization license is observed.
acceptance_cases.intended_result: Do not infer a production contract or exclusive supply relationship.

acceptance_cases.scenario: Payment depends on a threshold or repayment completion.
acceptance_cases.intended_result: Keep trigger and effective period; do not accrue an unconditional rate.

acceptance_cases.scenario: Company-wide pricing drivers and product-specific sales appear together.
acceptance_cases.intended_result: Do not attribute the group pricing effect to an individual drug without evidence.

acceptance_cases.scenario: Curation is published after the underlying report period and issuer publication.
acceptance_cases.intended_result: Preserve all clocks and their grain; do not backdate system knowledge.

acceptance_cases.scenario: The same URL/date delivers changed source bytes.
acceptance_cases.intended_result: Different immutable revision and explicit successor relationship; no old-ID overwrite.

acceptance_cases.scenario: An analyst revises an interpretation but the source contract has not changed.
acceptance_cases.intended_result: Identify interpretation change separately from amended business reality.

acceptance_cases.scenario: A source is withdrawn while historical observations remain stored.
acceptance_cases.intended_result: Suppress the dependent current conclusion; retain lawful history without a rights bypass.

acceptance_cases.scenario: A displayed acceptance time has no identified timezone.
acceptance_cases.intended_result: Preserve the literal/grain and unknown timezone; no guessed UTC conversion.

acceptance_cases.scenario: Two native evidence-subject blocks appear beside a company panel.
acceptance_cases.intended_result: Do not present them as a compiled security-subject recipe unless the bridge is consumed.

acceptance_cases.scenario: An opted-in assertion subtype drops an upstream clock.
acceptance_cases.intended_result: Refuse/degrade that subtype; legacy evidence success does not qualify the richer body.

acceptance_cases.scenario: A source names one formulation/version/territory.
acceptance_cases.intended_result: No automatic spread to all formulations or countries.

acceptance_cases.scenario: National status Current; manufacturer presentation Available.
acceptance_cases.intended_result: Retain Current and Available as different observations.

acceptance_cases.scenario: One observed molecule is current and another is resolved.
acceptance_cases.intended_result: Preserve mixed evidence; never emit a theme-wide resolution/all-clear.

acceptance_cases.scenario: Only discontinued products are observed.
acceptance_cases.intended_result: Use distinct machine semantics; never treat discontinuation as resolved supply.

acceptance_cases.scenario: A matching row contains an unrecognized status.
acceptance_cases.intended_result: Show observed-but-unclassified; do not report no matching records.

acceptance_cases.scenario: Page two fails after page one succeeded.
acceptance_cases.intended_result: Do not promote partial data as the new qualified observation; expose failed refresh.

acceptance_cases.scenario: A successful empty result and a network failure both yield no new rows.
acceptance_cases.intended_result: Distinguish complete empty observation from failed acquisition and stale cache.

acceptance_cases.scenario: Counts reconcile but the upstream has no immutable snapshot token.
acceptance_cases.intended_result: Record the acquisition window/consistency checks; do not claim atomic snapshot proof.

acceptance_cases.scenario: A record disappears from a later qualified complete observation.
acceptance_cases.intended_result: Retain prior history and record current absence basis, not stale present-tense membership.

acceptance_cases.scenario: A legacy cache overwrote earlier states.
acceptance_cases.intended_result: Mark historical coverage unavailable; begin truthful forward retention, not hindsight backfill.

acceptance_cases.scenario: A retained earlier qualified generation survives a failed refresh.
acceptance_cases.intended_result: Show its age and failed refresh; never replace source time with render time.

acceptance_cases.scenario: An allowed policy changes at the same path while the reader is warm.
acceptance_cases.intended_result: Apply the effective new revision within the accepted refresh contract; do not trust path cache.

acceptance_cases.scenario: A source family or required field-purpose authorization is unknown.
acceptance_cases.intended_result: Suppress dependent body; do not use legacy house basket rights as a blanket grant.

acceptance_cases.scenario: An anonymous or expired-session request targets a valid private record.
acceptance_cases.intended_result: Entitlement denial precedes private body access; no credential or object-key leakage.

acceptance_cases.scenario: Public HTML/JSON/Git/mirror contains the current protected assertion body.
acceptance_cases.intended_result: Release fails even if the main API is paywalled; use an independently approved safe shell.

acceptance_cases.scenario: A late paid response arrives after logout or after a newer request superseded it.
acceptance_cases.intended_result: Do not repopulate cleared/stale UI; no persistent private browser storage.

acceptance_cases.scenario: 401/403/404/503 and malformed-route paths are exercised.
acceptance_cases.intended_result: Preserve private-no-store and safe errors; storage details remain server-side.

acceptance_cases.scenario: A required object has wrong bytes, length or manifest identity.
acceptance_cases.intended_result: Refuse the generation; any eligible older display must be explicit, not silent substitution.

acceptance_cases.scenario: The expected predecessor changed before pointer promotion.
acceptance_cases.intended_result: Reconcile conflict on the same owner; no unconditional overwrite or parallel publisher.

acceptance_cases.scenario: A pointer write response is lost after dispatch.
acceptance_cases.intended_result: Keep effect unknown; read exact key/predecessor before retry or another effect.

acceptance_cases.scenario: One upstream field is restricted while a separable field is permitted.
acceptance_cases.intended_result: Enforce actual field/use scope; neither full-source laundering nor unsupported blanket approval.

acceptance_cases.scenario: Operating evidence exists but contemporaneous consensus/price baseline does not.
acceptance_cases.intended_result: Explain the operating change; withhold underpricing, expected-return and target-price claims.

acceptance_cases.scenario: Reader enters from the existing theme and opens the research module.
acceptance_cases.intended_result: Reader can state change, mechanism, participant, counterevidence and next observation.

acceptance_cases.scenario: New accurate text appears beside an unchanged unsupported glut chip.
acceptance_cases.intended_result: Fail coherence until the incumbent output is repaired or explicitly superseded; preserve old valid controls.

acceptance_cases.scenario: Issuer filing and press release repeat the same upstream information.
acceptance_cases.intended_result: Preserve two sources without automatically counting two independent confirmations.

source_limitations: Selected repository passages, not a runtime audit.
No live private source bodies or credential reads.
Public web reads are not native retention.
No full current FDA census or patient data.
No new current stock valuation or consensus acquired.
what_must_not_be_redone: R1-R7 research absent a material invalidator.
R7 characterization is historical behavior, not intended repair acceptance.
No copied Healthcare graph/store/publisher or API process.
